mobbin:d7ecf80a-5cb1-4429-ab2f-b2c40a50f.summary: From the Meetings list, the user accepts a green auto-record banner, chooses All meetings or Next meeting, sees a confirmation toast, and lands back on the list with the banner gone.
steps: Meetings list — Turn on auto record banner
Banner CTA — All meetings vs Next meeting
steal: Persistent green banner on the recording library: benefit copy + one CTA, dismissible X (step 1) — surfaces zero-touch recording without hunting settings.
Decision point: All meetings vs Next meeting only (step 2) — permanent default vs one-session trial without a settings page.
Bottom-right toast 'Auto-record settings updated' (step 3) — confirms the preference change without leaving the list.
avoid: Enabling auto-record only from the finished-meetings library (steps 1–4) — sim operators need the same choice on schedule/room overview before the session starts, not after.
mobbin:d7ecf80a-5cb1-4429-ab2f-b2c40a50f.fit: Would sit outside SRV on Center Overview / room schedule as auto-record by schedule or next session (not a bigger Record button inside SRV); banner+scope choice replaces hunting mixer settings.

mobbin:6b6443d7-dcb9-4e6e-b6a1-d82455a1f.summary: On a Coaching playback with Scorecard open, the coach picks Add Scorecard, chooses speaker + rubric + visibility, answers Y/N and 1–5 items with optional notes, submits, and sees the filled scorecard under the video with Send to Sam.
steps: New Scorecard modal — speaker, rubric, visibility
Expanded note field under engagement scale
Scorecard under video — submitted Y/N + 1–5 + note
steal: Scorecard lives as a tab under the video beside Overview/Metrics/Comments (step 1) — grade while watching without leaving playback.
Per-criterion 1–5 with red→orange→green selection + Avg. score badge (step 1) — instant visual heat map for faculty.
New Scorecard gate: pick speaker, scorecard template, viewable-by before Score Sam (step 3) — learner-scoped grading, not session-wide.
N/A checkbox + Add Note under each item; Submit disabled until answered (steps 4–7) — skip irrelevant items and attach evidence text.
avoid: Modal overlays the video for the whole grading pass (steps 3–7) — faculty cannot scrub the recording while answering; prefer inline Data Entry that stays beside the player.
mobbin:6b6443d7-dcb9-4e6e-b6a1-d82455a1f.fit: Extends SRV Data Entry / evaluation checklist into a speaker-scoped Scorecard tab under the player (like Abbott checklist), with color 1–5 + Send-to-learner; does not replace Annotation markers.

mobbin:9bc50bc4-4eab-47a8-845f-aeb3a21b4.summary: From Scorecard Unavailable, the coach starts Score this call, selects a speaker, waits through Generating Scorecard, then reviews AI-filled 1–5 criteria with expandable evidence notes and jump-to timestamps.
steps: AI scorecard — Avg. score + color 1–5 rows
steal: Empty/mismatch state with honest copy + Score this call fallback (step 1) — AI may not match the session type; manual start stays available.
Must select speaker before Score (steps 2–4) — grades one learner in a multi-person recording.
Generating Scorecard with progress bar and parallel Score this call (step 5) — wait state without trapping the user.
Expanded criterion shows AI rationale plus clickable evidence timestamp (step 7) — score linked to moment on the timeline.
avoid: Auto-applying a sales-pattern scorecard when the meeting 'does not match' (step 1) — sim rubrics must be faculty-owned checklists, not inferred call patterns.
mobbin:9bc50bc4-4eab-47a8-845f-aeb3a21b4.fit: Adds AI-suggested scores with evidence timestamps into SRV Data Entry/Scorecard (beside Annotation markers); empty+manual Score this call maps to rubric not auto-matched to the scenario.
